Resolves #21334

Every field workbench now shows its field in the states that apply to its type. `Neo.examples.form.field.StatesViewport` is the template: an entry declares its field once and the states it has. The live field, which the inspector drives, is the filled state and stays the stage's first item; below it, captioned, the same field renders empty with its placeholder, invalid with its own message, disabled and read-only. The 16 field entries adopt it with the labels a form would use, and Country, Currency, Display, IBAN, Password, Phone, Range, Search and ZIP code get their first entries.

Evidence: L3 (unit spec over all 25 entries; e2e specs in Chromium; headless frames and tile captures on the dev server, before and after) → L3 required (AC-1 to AC-5). Residual: AC-5, Residual-Owner: #21333.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI: `StatesViewport.spec.mjs` "every entry leads its stage with the live field and follows it with the states its type lists" (all 25), "an empty state shows no value and a placeholder, wherever its field has one" (all 25) and "an inspector change reaches the live field and leaves the states as they are"; `WorkbenchReset.spec.mjs` "field Reset restores the rendered label and its inspector textbox" drives the live text field in Chromium |
| AC-2 | CI: the same "every entry leads its stage …" test covers the nine new entries. Outside CI: all 25 entries opened at 1440 × 900 on the dev server, no console error |
| AC-3 | CI: `StatesViewport.spec.mjs` "no stage title is a class name" (all 25) |
| AC-4 | Outside CI: the frames below, chip, file upload and IBAN at 1440 × 900 and 390 × 844, dark |
| AC-5 | CI: `CaptureExamples.spec.mjs` "the committed tile list names workbench entries that exist" over the 25 listed field entries. The records arrive with their crops in #21333 |

## Deltas from ticket

- **File upload.** The entry was seven uploaders against the local test server, under the text entry's `className`. It now shows one live uploader whose server answer the inspector picks (five scenarios), above four document states that render from preset documents without a server. The uploaded one is `UN_DOWNLOADABLE`: the demo server serves no documents, so it offers no download.
- Ten entries set `placeholderText` on their field for the Empty state: Chip, Color, ComboBox, CopyToClipboard, Country, Date, Display, Number, Text and Time. Select defaults to "Select…".
- `ConfigurationViewport` declares `componentName`, which `getComponentName()` already read.
- The check box and radio inspectors drop their `readOnly` control: `CheckBox` has no `readOnly`, so it changed nothing.
- Each field on the stage gets a deep copy of its config, so nested configs (a store, a document) are never shared.
- The empty and invalid states pass `value: null`. Out of scope, noted in a defect-note (18 Nov 16:50Z): a field built without a value shows its clear trigger while empty under `clearToOriginalValue` (`src/form/field/trigger/Clear.mjs`).
- Out of scope per #21329 ("the email field's error layout"): an invalid field with a left label shrinks its input for the message, which the IBAN frames show.
- Specs: `NativeSelectNL` finds the live select by its name `fruit` and steps up from the filled Strawberry to Lemon (`0`); its placeholder test clears the value first. The tile-list check in `CaptureExamples.spec.mjs` accepts a `StatesViewport` entry. `Text.spec.mjs`'s two counter tests read the live field, the container's first item, and its own count.

The phone stage keeps its 280 px height and scrolls the states.

**Tile recipe, red and green.** The date tile at `1bef86e279` shows the live field alone. With the new hide line removed, the same crop catches the top of the states sheet: [with the line](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/d72884fa4b6590d85b6cc69371f45959e29d114d/review-evidence/21334/tile-date-after.jpg?raw=true) · [without it](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/d72884fa4b6590d85b6cc69371f45959e29d114d/review-evidence/21334/tile-date-without-hide.jpg?raw=true).

**Unit stubs, red and green.** CI's first `unit` run at `1f301d71be` failed 3 of the spec's 6 tests on their first attempt with `Neo.main.DomAccess.applyBodyCls is not a function`, then passed on retry. The stubs were installed once per file, and other spec files in the same worker replace `Neo.main.DomAccess` or delete its methods. Locally, over the `examples`, `main`, `container`, `app` and `component` unit folders: the old spec fails 5 of 765, with the same error in 3 of 3 runs. At `f77095ef78`, which installs the stubs per test, it passes 765 of 765 in 3 of 3 runs.

## Cold look

Two readers without session context graded the unlabelled chip pair at 1440 × 900, in swapped order: released 3 and 4, this head 7 and 7. Both preferred this head, because it shows the field's states and validation in use. Both named the empty band above the field and the low contrast of the states on dark; one found the disabled and read-only chips cramped.
